input: 상업 이용 가능, 0.6B 이하, 입력 8192 토큰 이상인 한국어 임베딩 모델이 필요해. CPU에서 돌릴 거야.
outputs: The model is a Korean embedding model designed for commercial use, featuring a parameter count of 0.6 billion or less. It supports an input context length of over 8192 tokens, making it suitable for processing long texts efficiently. This model is optimized for CPU performance, ensuring accessibility for various applications without the need for high-end hardware. Intended use cases include natural language understanding, semantic search, and text classification in Korean. Its strengths lie in its ability to generate high-quality embeddings that capture the nuances of the Korean language, making it a valuable tool for developers and researchers working in the field of natural language processing.
